name: SunArcOpeningHours
job: Show weekly opening hours as a sun's arc across a sky that shifts from dawn to dusk, with the open stretch glowing and a live "Open now, closes at 9pm" badge
visitor_action: tap or hover a weekday to see its arc; arrow keys switch days
mobile: arc fills the width, weekday chips below, swipe to change day
motion: sun travels along the arc and settles on the current time with spring, sky colour eases between days (reduced-motion: sun parked at opening time, static sky)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Dawn lido: peach-to-periwinkle gradient sky, butter-yellow sun disc with soft bloom, deep indigo text, fine film grain
notes: Not yet seen in a browser (QA sweep captures it). Hours spilling past midnight are drawn on the day they start; the live status ignores the previous night's spill-over. 2026-11-23: targeted fix (Sonnet 5.5, QA fail): 2-letter weekday chips when full names don't fit, end labels kept >=24px inside the card (arc inset + inside-arc labels when compact, fade under the sun), readout clearance from the arc increased. Not re-shot.
